description: Create a fermentation batch tracking spreadsheet to monitor 4 active batches (kombucha and mead). Set up columns for Batch Name, Beverage Type, Start Date, Target Days, Days Elapsed (with TODAY() formula), and Status (with IF formula showing 'Ready to Bottle' or 'Still Fermenting'). Enter data for 4 batches with varying start dates and verify formulas calculate correctly. Save as fermentation_tracker.xlsx.
